adversarial.question: Give me every order combined with every customer and every product.
adversarial.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
  o.order_id AS order_order_id,
  o.customer_id AS order_customer_id,
  o.employee_id AS order_employee_id,
  o.order_date AS order_date,
  o.status AS order_status,
  o.shipped_date AS order_shipped_date,
  c.customer_id AS customer_customer_id,
  c.first_name AS customer_first_name,
  c.last_name AS customer_last_name,
  c.city AS customer_city,
  c.state AS customer_state,
  c.region AS customer_region,
  p.product_id AS product_product_id,
  p.name AS product_name,
  p.category AS product_category,
  ROUND(p.list_price, 2) AS product_list_price,
  p.discontinued AS product_discontinued
FROM dbo.orders AS o
CROSS JOIN dbo.customers AS c
CROSS JOIN dbo.products AS p
